CREATE TYPE "public"."processing_method" AS ENUM ('washed', 'natural', 'honey', 'anaerobic', 'wet_hulled');
CREATE TYPE "public"."product_type" AS ENUM ('coffee', 'tea', 'chocolate');
CREATE TYPE "public"."roast_level" AS ENUM ('light', 'medium_light', 'medium', 'medium_dark', 'dark');

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "product_type" product_type NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "weight_grams" integer NOT NULL,
  "tags" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "origin_country" text,
  "origin_region" text,
  "farm_name" text,
  "altitude_meters" int4range,
  "variety" text,
  "processing_method" processing_method,
  "roast_level" roast_level,
  "tasting_notes" jsonb,
  "roast_date" date,
  "best_by_date" date,
  "attributes" jsonb,
  "created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "products_altitude_not_empty" CHECK (altitude_meters IS NULL OR NOT isempty(altitude_meters)),
  CONSTRAINT "products_attributes_is_object" CHECK (attributes IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(attributes) = 'object'::text),
  CONSTRAINT "products_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "products_price_check" CHECK (price >= 0::numeric),
  CONSTRAINT "products_retrofit_shape" CHECK (product_type = 'coffee'::product_type AND origin_country IS NOT NULL AND origin_region IS NOT NULL AND variety IS NOT NULL AND processing_method IS NOT NULL AND roast_level IS NOT NULL AND tasting_notes IS NOT NULL AND roast_date IS NOT NULL AND best_by_date IS NOT NULL AND attributes IS NULL OR (product_type = ANY (ARRAY['tea'::product_type, 'chocolate'::product_type])) AND origin_country IS NULL AND origin_region IS NULL AND farm_name IS NULL AND altitude_meters IS NULL AND variety IS NULL AND processing_method IS NULL AND roast_level IS NULL AND tasting_notes IS NULL AND roast_date IS NULL AND best_by_date IS NULL AND attributes IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "products_tags_is_array" CHECK (jsonb_typeof(tags) = 'array'::text),
  CONSTRAINT "products_tasting_notes_is_array" CHECK (tasting_notes IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(tasting_notes) = 'array'::text),
  CONSTRAINT "products_weight_grams_check" CHECK (weight_grams > 0)
);
-- filter: under 500k
SELECT * FROM products

CREATE TYPE "public"."instrument_type" AS ENUM ('equity', 'etf', 'crypto');

CREATE TABLE "public"."instruments" (
  "instrument_id" bigint DEFAULT nextval('instruments_instrument_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL,
  "symbol" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "instrument_type" instrument_type NOT NULL,
  "primary_exchange_id" smallint NOT NULL,
  "currency_code" character(3) DEFAULT 'USD'::bpchar NOT NULL,
  "cusip" character(9),
  "isin" character(12),
  "figi" text,
  "crypto_network" text,
  "crypto_contract_address" text,
  "share_scale" smallint DEFAULT 4 NOT NULL,
  "is_tradable" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "instruments_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("instrument_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "instruments_primary_exchange_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (primary_exchange_id) REFERENCES exchanges(exchange_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT "instruments_share_scale_ck" CHECK (share_scale >= 0 AND share_scale <= 8),
  CONSTRAINT "instruments_symbol_uq" UNIQUE ("primary_exchange_id", "symbol")
);
